data.taskBrief:
Create a new employee record in Xero (Xero Accounting API)

FIT
  Fully. The supplied Xero Employees endpoint creates employee records, including names and an optional external link. No supplied requests are irrelevant.

AUTH
  OAuth 2.0 access token
  Header: Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. Supply a valid Xero access token; the collection indicates it is added to the header. Also provide the required tenant identifier in the xero-tenant-id header.

BASE URL
  https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0

STEPS
  1. PUT /Employees
     Params:
       summarizeErrors: query string — 'false'; keeps the request at the shown path and allows a 200 response containing successful records and validation errors.
       xero-tenant-id: header string — '<tenant-id>'; the required Xero tenant identifier.
       Content-Type: header string — 'application/json'.
       Employees: JSON body array — include one employee object, for example:
         FirstName: string — 'Nick' (body)
         LastName: string — 'Fury' (body)
         ExternalLink: object — optional (body), with Url: string — 'http://twitter.com/#!/search/Nick+Fury' (body); LinkType and Description are also shown as fields.
       EmployeeID, Status, StatusAttributeString, and ValidationErrors are also shown in the employee object schema; the request example creates an employee using FirstName, LastName, and ExternalLink only.
     Returns:
       200 OK with Id, Status, ProviderName, DateTimeUTC, and an Employees array. The returned employee example includes EmployeeID, Status, FirstName, LastName, ExternalLink, and UpdatedDateUTC. A validation failure can return 400 Bad Request with ErrorNumber, Type, Message, and an Elements array containing ValidationErrors.
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Send the body as JSON with the Employees array nested at the top level.
  - Include both Authorization and xero-tenant-id headers; the tenant ID is required and is not resolved by the supplied collection variable.
  - The collection resolves baseUrl to https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0.
  - Access tokens expire after 30 minutes according to the collection description; refresh or replace the token when necessary.
  - With summarizeErrors=false, inspect the 200 response for per-record validation errors as well as successfully created employees; a validation failure may instead return 400 with validation details.
